lessons.title: Your first hello
lessons.objective: Greet someone in Italian, say goodbye and express thanks.
lessons.explanation:
Your first words

Ciao — hello
Arrivederci — goodbye
Grazie — thank you
Buongiorno — good morning

Start a conversation with a greeting. Use a morning greeting early in the day. Read the examples, then practise choosing and writing these expressions.

lessons.title: Explaining your opinion
lessons.objective: Connect sentences to present a view, contrast and conclusion.
lessons.explanation:
Explaining your opinion

Secondo me, lavorare da casa ha diversi vantaggi. — In my opinion, working from home has several advantages.
Per esempio, non perdi tempo andando al lavoro. — For example, you do not spend time travelling to work.
D’altra parte, può essere più difficile separare il lavoro dalla vita privata. — On the other hand, it can be harder to separate work from personal life.
Per questo preferirei lavorare in ufficio due giorni alla settimana. — That is why I would prefer to work in the office two days a week.

Secondo me introduces an opinion; d’altra parte gives a contrasting point; per questo links the conclusion.
